title: Ravi, 1 AM
draft: Claude's draft 2026-10-17 from story_script_v1 §5 (2.5) + §4 (1.2, Ravi as a peer), 3.1–3.4 and 4.x (ravi_supported changes the ending), ADR-03 (an accident, not a villain — the system is the antagonist), ADR-19 (stress: the player carries Ravi's meter), ADR-36 (the Appa call in the corridor), whiteboard_salvage (stress, identity fading). The user edits the words and the numbers; then P14 builds it.
time: The night after 2.4: the first sleep after act2_ikea_done is cut short — Ravi's message wakes you at 00:50
player_goal: Find Ravi at the shuttle stop at 1 AM.
design_goal: Conflict + Quiet dread: the first scene at night, and the first choice that has no right answer, only a cost. The player meets Ravi at his lowest — unpaid, sleepless, alone on the agri-samples — and decides what kind of friend to be. `ravi_supported` drives 3.x and the ending (act4 Ground Zero). Reveal: night-time (a reusable night look), autos at double fare after midnight.

cast.role: Sitting on the shuttle-bay bench under the one working light, hood up, shaking. Thirty hours awake; the lab put him on the agri-samples alone; his sister's wedding loan (₹3 lakh, his name on it); the stipend still 'processing'. One line of foreshadowing: Appa calls at the worst times, even in the corridor.
The night guard with a torch: 'That boy has been there since eleven. I gave him tea. He didn't drink it.'

beats.what: The first sleep after the IKEA run is cut short: at 00:50 the phone buzzes (critical, through Do Not Disturb) — Ravi: 'u up? im at the shuttle stop. cant go back in. cant go home.' The clock says 00:50; the flat is dark (the night look).

Getting there at night: buses stopped at 23:00 (the hill bus says so); the scooter if you own one (RIDE), otherwise the hill's last auto at double fare (₹160) to the office gate. The tech park at 1 AM: the night look, the guard's torch, the office block dark except one floor, the shuttle bay's single light.

Ravi on the bench. Four short exchanges (the samples, the loan, the stipend, Appa's calls), then the choice: sit with him till the first shuttle (an hour passes; stress +5 for you, he gets a little calmer) · give him ₹2,000 for the loan instalment (he refuses twice, then takes it, hands shaking) · or 'I have work tomorrow' and leave. Sitting and giving can both happen; leaving ends it.

Home at 3 AM (auto ₹160 again, or the scooter), sleep. Morning: if you stayed or gave, Ravi's chat — 'thank you. dont tell anyone i cried. i'll pay you back after the processing finishes.' If you left: nothing. His last message stays the one about the stipend. Stress follows you either way.
